correctness.rationale: Exact all-dimensional proof. Positive integral operator C has eigenvalues c_l>0; multiplication M_z connects only adjacent degrees. Conjugating aC+|v|(MC+CM) by C^{-1/2} gives aI+|v|J with off-diagonal weights (c_l+c_{l+1})/sqrt(c_l c_{l+1}); parity reverses J and establishes exact finite-norm cutoff. Uniform adjacent ratios bound J by Schur/Cauchy, while normalized zonal coefficient A_{l,d}→1/2 supplies negative two-degree minors when ratios are unbounded. Fractional λ_l^alpha has bounded increments exactly when alpha≤1/2 (concavity versus asymptotic growth). The proof checks d=2 separately, all a,v boundaries, and finite-site versus integral equivalence. Standalone finite calculations supplement rather than establish the infinite theorem; exact Legendre and constructive numerical checks were replayed from the new package.
